1 ” to allow audio playback METHOD OF TRADE USED IN THE COUNTY [Music] Hello Learner, welcome to Social Studies for grade four. Today, we are going to learn about method of trade used in the county and the benefits of trade in the county. Your radio teacher is Esther Simaloi. Welcome to the program. [Music]

2 ” to allow audio playback Hello grade 4 learner. Welcome to our social studies radio listen. In today's lesson, we shall learn about economic activities in the county. We shall also learn about the importance of the main economic activities carried out in the county. First Let us remind ourselves what we learned in the previous lesson. Learner, What are resources? What are resources.? #Bell# Resources are things around us that we can use to create wealth. Can you remember the resources we mentioned? Can you remember the resources we mentioned? #Bell# Well done. I hope your answers include Soil Water Wildlife Land Forests and Minerals We also learned of the importance of resources in the county. Do you remember? State two. #Bell# Good. Today, we shall learn about the main economic activities in your county. Learner, what are economic activities? What are economic activities? #Bell# Economic activities are things people do to make money. Economic activities are things people do to make money. This activities involve the use of natural resources to produce wealth. Which economic activities are done in your county? Which economic activities are done in your county? #Bell# Economic activities we practice in our county bring us wealth. These activities may include the following; 1. Trading, trading involves people buying and selling of goods and services. Trading involves people buying and selling of goods and services. Where do people buy and sell goods and services in your area? Where do people buy and sell goods and services in your area? #Bell# Well done. I hope your answers include; Shops, Market, Hotels and Garage,

3 ” to allow audio playback Fishing is another economic activity. What is fishing? What is fishing? #Bell# People catch fish from rivers, lakes, dams and fish ponds. People sell fish caught from rivers, lakes or dams to make money. Another economic activity is forestry. We plant trees and take care of them. Some trees in the forest provide wood used for making paper. The books and newspapers we read and the exercise books we write on are made from trees. Farming is another economic activity. What is farming? #Bell# People grow crops and keep animals. Which crops are grown in your home area? #Bell# Which animals are kept in your home area? #Bell# Another economic activity is tourism. People travel to places of interest for enjoyment or pleasure. Is there an area you would like to visit in your county? Which area is that? #Bell# Why would you like to visit that area? #Bell# Then you will be a domestic tourist. Economic activities are important in our county. This is because, They provide food Tourism, brings money to our county. Economic activities create employment. They are a source of income to many people in the county. Economic activities provide raw materials for industries, for example, milk for dairy industry. Cotton for textile industry. Economic activities promote cultural exchange. When tourists visit and interact with the people in the county, they exchange ideas and cultural values. It promotes unity when people meet in various economic activities in the county. These in turn provides good citizenship. To conclude, discuss with your parents or guardians the economic activities they do. Ask the importance of these economic activities. We come to the end of our lesson today. Until next time. Goodbye. # Music#
